h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Bhilai

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Bhilai

items.pText: Bhilai grew up around its steel plant, and the township is laid out in sectors, each with its own schools, markets and parks. That layout makes Bhilai different from most cities we supply. FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor playground equipment for township parks, schools, housing societies and private colonies in Bhilai and Durg at our Vasai factory, about 910 km away.

When one body looks after many parks across a township, consistency helps. If every sector park uses the same set of equipment models, spares are easier to stock, maintenance staff learn one routine, and residents in every sector get the same standard. We can prepare a standard package for small, medium and large parks and adapt the layout for each site. Chhattisgarh has hot summers and a strong monsoon, so plan the base and drainage too.

items.q: Can you supply the same equipment to many parks?
items.a: Yes. We can set a standard package for small, medium and large parks, then adapt each layout to its site. Using the same models makes spare parts and maintenance simpler.

items.q: What should a large township park include?
items.a: Usually a multi play system as the centrepiece, a separate toddler corner with spring riders, and swings set apart from the walking paths. We plan these on one layout drawing.

items.q: Do you deliver to Bhilai and Durg?
items.a: Yes. We send equipment from our Vasai factory by road and install it with our team or a dealer in Chhattisgarh.
